environment: local Hardhat + Flask + simulated EIP-1193 wallet
checks: Flask verifies deployed bytecode and serves real chain data
Wallet menu lists permitted accounts, supports keyboard control and preserves selection on permission rejection
Input validation, deposit, mined confirmation and exact shares
Excess withdrawal rejection and partial redemption
Account switching isolates positions and histories

All-activity wallet menu switches the viewed account and updates its URL
Reload remembers an authorized selection and falls back when that account is no longer exposed

Browser wallet deployment produces confirmed address and deployment block
RPC failure becomes an explicit error and disables writes
